body:
Hey @darthsitthiander, I assume you saw [the guide](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/angular-integration.html) we made, since you seem to use similar terminology. 

However, I'm not sure if what you posted in this thread is enough to make it clear what the actual issue is you're facing, can you make a complete example, based on the one we made in the guide, and explain where something goes wrong? Thanks!

P.S.: For anyone visiting this thread, we're currently making a version of InstantSearch, just for Angular, please fill in [this form](https://goo.gl/forms/US09OkyYKByeF1W53) if you want to be contacted when we make a beta version available.
